# Create genomic-range objects, how many intervals overlap between control and knockdown?

```{r }

library(GenomicRanges)

# Preserve the supplied coordinates for this exploratory comparison.
# Verify their convention before BED export or external annotation.
control_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = control$chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(start = control$start, end = control$end)
)

knockdown_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = knockdown$chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(start = knockdown$start, end = knockdown$end)
)

# TRUE if an interval overlaps at least one interval in the other sample
control_shared <- overlapsAny(control_gr, knockdown_gr)
knockdown_shared <- overlapsAny(knockdown_gr, control_gr)

overlap_summary = data.frame(
  sample = c("Control", "HDAC7 knockdown"),
  total_intervals = c(length(control_gr), length(knockdown_gr)),
  overlapping_other_sample = c(
    sum(control_shared),
    sum(knockdown_shared)
  ),
  no_overlap_other_sample = c(
    sum(!control_shared),
    sum(!knockdown_shared)
  ),
  percent_overlapping = round(
    100 * c(mean(control_shared), mean(knockdown_shared)),
    1
  )
)

overlap_summary

# Most called H3K9me3 intervals occur at shared genomic locations. However, “overlap”  here means sharing at least one base. A knockdown interval could overlap a control interval while being shorter, longer, or shifted.
# the 8,495 and 5,555 nonoverlapping intervals are sample-specific calls, rather than statistically established losses or gains yet

```

# Measure the fraction of each interval covered by the other sample’s intervals.
To avoid double-counting when multiple intervals overlap.

```{r }

# Combine overlapping intervals within each sample.
# min.gapwidth = 0 keeps merely adjacent intervals separate.
control_union <- reduce(control_gr, min.gapwidth = 0L)
knockdown_union <- reduce(knockdown_gr, min.gapwidth = 0L)

# Fraction of each query interval covered by the other sample
fraction_covered <- function(query, subject_union) {

  hits <- findOverlaps(query, subject_union)
  covered_bp <- numeric(length(query))

  if (length(hits) > 0L) {

    shared_pieces <- pintersect(
      query[queryHits(hits)],
      subject_union[subjectHits(hits)]
    )

    totals <- tapply(
      width(shared_pieces),
      queryHits(hits),
      sum
    )

    covered_bp[as.integer(names(totals))] <- as.numeric(totals)
  }

  covered_bp / width(query)
}

control$overlap_fraction <- fraction_covered(
  control_gr, knockdown_union
)

knockdown$overlap_fraction <- fraction_covered(
  knockdown_gr, control_union
)

summary(control$overlap_fraction)
summary(knockdown$overlap_fraction)


# This shows that HDAC7 Knockdown intervals are more extensively covered by control intervals than the reverse. Mean overalp is 76.4% vs 62% (Consistent with knockdown experiments)
```

# Know lets measure peak boundries acrross all the common genomic reaions (46511)

```{r }
# 
# Create a function to extract the mean signal
extract_region_means <- function(bw, regions, batch_size = 100L) {

  region_means <- rep(NA_real_, length(regions))

  chromosome_indices <- split(
    seq_along(regions),
    as.character(seqnames(regions))
  )

  for (chr in names(chromosome_indices)) {

    chr_idx <- chromosome_indices[[chr]]

    # Request regions in genomic order
    chr_idx <- chr_idx[
      order(start(regions[chr_idx]), end(regions[chr_idx]))
    ]

    batches <- split(
      chr_idx,
      ceiling(seq_along(chr_idx) / batch_size)
    )

    for (i in seq_along(batches)) {

      idx <- batches[[i]]

      signal <- rtracklayer::import(
        bw,
        which = regions[idx],
        as = "NumericList"
      )

      stopifnot(
        length(signal) == length(idx),
        all(
          S4Vectors::elementNROWS(signal) ==
            width(regions[idx])
        )
      )

      # Store means at their original region indices
      region_means[idx] <- vapply(
        signal, mean, numeric(1)
      )
    }

    message("Completed ", chr)
  }

  region_means
}


```

# 13. Now calculate the fold change within each matching region:

```{r }
# Require complete, positive signal before calculating ratios
stopifnot(
  nrow(region_signal) == length(common_regions),
  all(is.finite(region_signal$control_mean)),
  all(is.finite(region_signal$knockdown_mean)),
  all(region_signal$control_mean > 0),
  all(region_signal$knockdown_mean > 0)
)

region_signal$fold_change <- with(
  region_signal,
  knockdown_mean / control_mean
)

region_signal$log2FC <- log2(region_signal$fold_change)

summary(region_signal$log2FC)
```

# a 1.5-fold cutoff.
```{r }
# Select regions using a 1.5-fold linear change
log2_cutoff <- log2(1.5)

c(
  increased_1.5fold =
    sum(region_signal$log2FC >= log2_cutoff),

  decreased_1.5fold =
    sum(region_signal$log2FC <= -log2_cutoff),

  between_thresholds =
    sum(abs(region_signal$log2FC) < log2_cutoff)
)

# Store group labels for plots and downstream analysis
region_signal$selection_1.5fold <- ifelse(
  region_signal$log2FC >= log2_cutoff,
  "Higher in knockdown",
  ifelse(
    region_signal$log2FC <= -log2_cutoff,
    "Lower in knockdown",
    "Between thresholds"
  )
)

#Regions were selected using a descriptive threshold of ≥1.5-fold higher or lower normalized H3K9me3 signal in knockdown relative to control.
```

# Create the extraction function.
```{r }
make_center_matrix <- function(
    bw, regions, flank = 5000L, bin_size = 100L) {

  window_width <- 2L * flank
  stopifnot(window_width %% bin_size == 0L)

  centers <- start(regions) + (width(regions) - 1L) %/% 2L

  window_starts <- centers - flank
  window_ends <- centers + flank - 1L

  # Check that every complete window fits within its chromosome
  chr_lengths <- seqlengths(seqinfo(bw))[
    as.character(seqnames(regions))
  ]

  if (anyNA(chr_lengths)) {
    stop("Chromosome lengths are unavailable or names do not match.")
  }

  if (any(window_starts < 1L | window_ends > chr_lengths)) {
    stop("Some windows cross chromosome boundaries.")
  }

  windows <- GRanges(
    seqnames = seqnames(regions),
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = window_starts,
      end = window_ends
    )
  )

  result <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(regions),
    ncol = window_width / bin_size
  )

  for (i in seq_along(windows)) {

    signal <- rtracklayer::import(
      bw,
      which = windows[i],
      as = "NumericList"
    )

    stopifnot(
      length(signal) == 1L,
      length(signal[[1]]) == window_width
    )

    # Each column contains 100 consecutive genomic bases
    bins <- matrix(
      as.numeric(signal[[1]]),
      nrow = bin_size
    )

    result[i, ] <- colMeans(bins)

    if (i %% 100L == 0L || i == length(windows)) {
      message("Completed ", i, " of ", length(windows), " regions")
    }
  }

  result
}
```

# Prepare the matrices for plotting
```{r }

matrix_to_table <- function(mat, row_order, group, sample) {

  mat <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

  data.frame(
    position_kb = rep(positions_kb, each = nrow(mat)),
    region_rank = rep(seq_len(nrow(mat)), times = ncol(mat)),
    signal = as.vector(mat),
    group = group,
    sample = sample
  )
}

heatmap_data <- rbind(
  matrix_to_table(
    higher_control_matrix, higher_order,
    "Higher in knockdown (399 regions)", "Control"
  ),
  matrix_to_table(
    higher_knockdown_matrix, higher_order,
    "Higher in knockdown (399 regions)", "HDAC7 knockdown"
  ),
  matrix_to_table(
    lower_control_matrix, lower_order,
    "Lower in knockdown (2,484 regions)", "Control"
  ),
  matrix_to_table(
    lower_knockdown_matrix, lower_order,
    "Lower in knockdown (2,484 regions)", "HDAC7 knockdown"
  )
)

heatmap_data$sample <- factor(
  heatmap_data$sample,
  levels = c("Control", "HDAC7 knockdown")
)

heatmap_data$group <- factor(
  heatmap_data$group,
  levels = c(
    "Higher in knockdown (399 regions)",
    "Lower in knockdown (2,484 regions)"
  )
)

```

```{r }
) +
```

# H3K9me3 signal profiles and Heatmaps together
```{r }
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# Positions for the existing 100-bin matrices.
# Keep these consistent with your original extraction coordinates.
positions_kb <- seq(
  from = -4950.5,
  by = 100,
  length.out = 100
) / 1000

matrices <- list(
  higher_control_matrix,
  higher_knockdown_matrix,
  lower_control_matrix,
  lower_knockdown_matrix
)

stopifnot(
  all(vapply(matrices, ncol, integer(1)) == length(positions_kb)),
  nrow(higher_control_matrix) == nrow(higher_knockdown_matrix),
  nrow(lower_control_matrix) == nrow(lower_knockdown_matrix)
)

# Use the same row order for both conditions within each group.
# Sort by control signal near the center.
central_bins <- abs(positions_kb) <= 1

higher_order <- order(
  rowMeans(higher_control_matrix[, central_bins, drop = FALSE]),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

lower_order <- order(
  rowMeans(lower_control_matrix[, central_bins, drop = FALSE]),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

# Profile plot
make_profile <- function(control, knockdown, title) {

  dat <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      position_kb = positions_kb,
      signal = colMeans(control),
      sample = "siControl"
    ),
    data.frame(
      position_kb = positions_kb,
      signal = colMeans(knockdown),
      sample = "siHDAC7"
    )
  )

  ggplot(dat, aes(position_kb, signal, color = sample)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "siControl" = "#756BB1",
        "siHDAC7" = "#A6D96A"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
      labels = c("-1 kb", "Center", "+1 kb"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean signal",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 12, 5, 5)
    )
}

# Heatmap: each row is one genomic region.
make_heatmap <- function(mat, row_order, condition,
                         show_x = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE) {

  mat <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

  dat <- data.frame(
    position_kb = rep(positions_kb, each = nrow(mat)),
    region = rep(nrow(mat):1, times = ncol(mat)),
    signal = as.vector(mat)
  )

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(position_kb, region, fill = signal)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c(
        "#A50026",   # Low: red
        "#F46D43",
        "#FEE090",
        "#E0F3F8",
        "#4575B4",
        "#313695"    # High: blue
      ),
      limits = c(0, 0.45),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Signal"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
      labels = c("-1 kb", "Center", "+1 kb"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = condition) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      legend.key.height = unit(0.7, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 12, 0, 5)
    )

  if (!show_x) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  }

  p
}

# Create compact profile plots
profile_style <- theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.position = "top",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
  plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
)

p_increased <- make_profile(
  higher_control_matrix,
  higher_knockdown_matrix,
  "Increased H3K9me3\n399 regions"
) + profile_style

p_decreased <- make_profile(
  lower_control_matrix,
  lower_knockdown_matrix,
  "Decreased H3K9me3\n2,484 regions"
) + profile_style

# Compact heatmap labels
heatmap_style <- theme(
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.08, "cm"),
  plot.margin = margin(2, 5, 2, 5)
)

h_inc_control <- make_heatmap(
  higher_control_matrix, higher_order, "siControl"
) + heatmap_style

h_inc_knockdown <- make_heatmap(
  higher_knockdown_matrix, higher_order, "siHDAC7",
  show_x = TRUE
) + heatmap_style

h_dec_control <- make_heatmap(
  lower_control_matrix, lower_order, "siControl"
) + heatmap_style

h_dec_knockdown <- make_heatmap(
  lower_knockdown_matrix, lower_order, "siHDAC7",
  show_x = TRUE
) + heatmap_style

# Extract one shared color legend
legend_source <- make_heatmap(
  lower_knockdown_matrix, lower_order, "siHDAC7",
  show_legend = TRUE
) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.7, "cm")
  )

legend_gtable <- ggplotGrob(legend_source)

legend_index <- which(vapply(
  legend_gtable$grobs,
  function(g) g$name == "guide-box",
  logical(1)
))

shared_legend <- legend_gtable$grobs[[legend_index[1]]]

# Convert panels to grobs and align their plotting areas
panel_grobs <- lapply(
  list(
    p_increased, p_decreased,
    h_inc_control, h_dec_control,
    h_inc_knockdown, h_dec_knockdown
  ),
  ggplotGrob
)

common_widths <- do.call(
  unit.pmax,
  lapply(panel_grobs, function(g) g$widths)
)

panel_grobs <- lapply(panel_grobs, function(g) {
  g$widths <- common_widths
  g
})

# Draw grobs directly, with sufficient space for the profiles
draw_figure <- function() {

  grid.newpage()

  pushViewport(viewport(
    width = 0.97,
    height = 0.97,
    layout = grid.layout(
      nrow = 3,
      ncol = 4,
      heights = unit(c(0.32, 0.34, 0.34), "null"),
      widths = unit(c(1, 0.045, 1, 0.18), "null")
    )
  ))

  draw_panel <- function(grob, row, column) {
    pushViewport(viewport(
      layout.pos.row = row,
      layout.pos.col = column
    ))
    grid.draw(grob)
    popViewport()
  }

  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[1]], 1, 1)
  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[2]], 1, 3)

  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[3]], 2, 1)
  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[4]], 2, 3)

  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[5]], 3, 1)
  draw_panel(panel_grobs[[6]], 3, 3)

  draw_panel(shared_legend, 2:3, 4)

  popViewport()
}

draw_figure()



# Visualize H3K9me3 signal around common-region centers.
# Regions are grouped using a descriptive 1.5-fold cutoff:
# 399 regions with higher signal and 2,484 with lower signal following HDAC7 knockdown.

# Each column contains average signal profiles above paired siControl and siHDAC7 heatmaps, displayed within ±1 kb.
# Regions are sorted by central siControl signal, with the same row order retained across conditions within each group.
# Heatmaps share a color scale capped at 0.45.
# These plots summarize signal intensity and variation across kd vs CT. Fold-change selection alone does not establish statistical significance, and these plots do not independently demonstrate heterochromatin spreading.
```

### We’ll annotate all 46,511 common regions first,


```{r }
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ggplot2)

plot_locus_tracks <- function(locus, flank_bp = 5000L) {

  chromosome <- as.character(locus$seqnames[1])
  region_start <- as.integer(locus$start[1])
  region_end <- as.integer(locus$end[1])

  chromosome_lengths <- vapply(
    bw_files[c("Control", "HDAC7_KD", "Input")],
    function(bw) {
      as.numeric(seqlengths(seqinfo(bw))[chromosome])
    },
    numeric(1)
  )

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(chromosome_lengths)))

  window_start <- max(1L, region_start - flank_bp)
  window_end <- min(
    min(chromosome_lengths),
    region_end + flank_bp
  )

  window <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chromosome,
    ranges = IRanges(window_start, window_end)
  )

  sample_labels <- c(
    Control = "Control",
    HDAC7_KD = "HDAC7 knockdown",
    Input = "Input"
  )

  track_data <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(sample_labels), function(sample_name) {

      signal <- rtracklayer::import(
        bw_files[[sample_name]],
        which = window,
        as = "NumericList"
      )

      stopifnot(
        length(signal) == 1L,
        length(signal[[1]]) == width(window)
      )

      data.frame(
        position_Mb = seq.int(
          window_start,
          window_end
        ) / 1e6,
        signal = as.numeric(signal[[1]]),
        sample = unname(sample_labels[sample_name])
      )
    })
  )

  track_data$sample <- factor(
    track_data$sample,
    levels = c("Control", "HDAC7 knockdown", "Input")
  )

  ggplot(
    track_data,
    aes(position_Mb, signal, color = sample)
  ) +
    geom_line(size = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(region_start, region_end) / 1e6,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    facet_grid(sample ~ .) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Control" = "#0072B2",
        "HDAC7 knockdown" = "#D55E00",
        "Input" = "grey35"
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(window_start, window_end) / 1e6
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("H3K9me3 tracks:", locus$region_id[1]),
      subtitle = paste0(
        chromosome, ":", region_start, "-", region_end,
        " | KD/control fold change = ",
        round(locus$fold_change[1], 2)
      ),
      x = paste0(chromosome, " position (Mb; hg38)"),
      y = "BigWig signal"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
    )
}
```

## Data scope and analysis design: 
**This notebook explores the publicly available H3K9me3 ChIP-seq tracks associated with the published study, using control, HDAC7 knockdown, and input data. It focuses on genomic coverage, signal visualization, and annotation of regions selected using an exploratory 1.5-fold change threshold. The analysis complements the publication by providing a reproducible workflow for examining the deposited tracks. Results are presented descriptively, with replicate-based statistical testing outside the scope of this notebook.**
